description: Create a private research job (Oxaide). Returns a job id immediately; a fixed quote is emailed within 1 business day. Request the full check with pay_audit before any work starts.

brief.description: The research question, in plain language (SG corporate/wealth topics: ACRA/URA/GeBIZ/CPF/REIT etc).

email.description: Delivery email. Quote, files, and refunds go here. Required: delivery is email-first.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (letters, numbers, _ and -, max 80). Repeating a create with the same key + email returns the first job instead of a second one.

webhook_url.description: Optional https URL posted once when the pack is delivered ({event: delivered, id, status: ready, track, downloads: {pdf, xlsx}}). One retry after 5 minutes if the first POST fails.

name: create_audit
title: Request Oxaide research
